description: This file defines the CRServiceWorker class, which extends the Worker class to manage service worker behavior within the Chromium server environment of Playwright. It handles interactions such as network interception, console message handling, session management, and lifecycle events for service workers.

classes.name: CRServiceWorker
classes.description: A class that manages service worker instances within Chromium, extending the base Worker class with additional functionality for network and session management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CRServiceWorker instance, setting up network management, session event listeners, and console message forwarding.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service worker is closed, removing session references and calling the superclass method.

methods.name: updateOffline
methods.description: Updates the offline status of the network manager based on browser context options.

methods.name: updateHttpCredentials
methods.description: Updates HTTP credentials for network requests based on browser context options.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers for network requests based on browser context options.

methods.name: updateRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures request interception behavior based on browser context settings.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Determines whether request interception is required based on network inspection settings and interceptors.

methods.name: reportRequestFinished
methods.description: Emits an event when a network request has finished, passing the request and response.

methods.name: requestFailed
methods.description: Emits an event when a network request has failed.

methods.name: requestReceivedResponse
methods.description: Emits an event when a network response is received.

methods.name: requestStarted
methods.description: Emits an event when a network request starts, and handles request interception if needed.

methods.name: _isNetworkInspectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network inspection is enabled based on the browser context options.

ctags.name: message
ctags.pattern: /^      const message = new ConsoleMessage(null, this, event.type, undefined, args, toConsoleMessa/
